First-time players choose a display language before the home menu. Automatic names follow the language at a fresh setup boundary and stay fixed throughout setup; typed names stay exact. The latest adjustment removes the empty orange warning frame from that screen while retaining real loading/error messages and live announcements. Human testing at 5252 accepts the chooser/name policy in a limited trial, and testing at 5256 confirms the strip is gone. Grave Accord remains the common title across languages.

The branch retains seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons, 66 bosses, six maps and five modes, with offline Solo, public/private waiting rooms, optional passwords, host-only Start/Pause/Continue, confirmed chat, profiles, encounter-boundary saves and persistent authority-written team records. Control edits retain focus, restore stored values after a failed save and cancel unused capture. The accepted gallery, camera/cover/Toad routes, pit-only lava, defeat preparation and Medic/shield rules remain.

Exact source **e639047fdb494f4cfb2b7d6738d5b08f8d14916e**, build **2026.10.30-welcome-finish / protocol 43**, passes **915 tests, 915 pass, 0 fail**, plus TypeScript, authored content/all 15 catalogs/native artwork, production build and 71 atlas contracts. Both complete source CI jobs pass: [124270947473](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/41116194072/job/124270947473) and [124270868228](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/41116170388/job/124270868228). [Source/review evidence](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/tree/feat/first-playable-loop/reviews/welcome-finish-2026-10-30) binds testing at 5256/backend2630 and public5257/backend2631: 49 served hashes each, all 15 catalogs and actual two-peer room/password/code/localized-name/chat/host/record flows. Initial Wiki 7840e03 matches 18 pages / 34 images; final limited human confirmation is published at **4d4fa8e04bf1b836c9f1627817f928cb9d896e6d** from records-only source e620627.

The [larger-team software review](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/tree/feat/first-playable-loop/reviews/multiplayer-progression-2026-10-30) passes an eight-player campaign, private sixteen-player Raid and fifty-player Endless sample. All seven classes use earned mixed builds, active input, equal-count votes, host pause/departure, replacement players and reconnect. Shared results survive a full server restart; 51 historical participants after turnover use two roster pages. A standalone 50-player and exact 16-then-50 instrumented repeat pass. The earlier 50-client join timeout remains preserved with its cause unproven. These are protected QA players and accelerated clears/deadlines with isolated records and zero rendered clients. Compiled authority/Session/probe bytes are identical in the current UI source.

The [matching local Windows review](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/tree/feat/first-playable-loop/reviews/windows-welcome-finish-2026-10-30) verifies all 1899 files before/after six native offline/LAN diagnostics across original, fresh ZIP extraction and independent Japanese-path copy. The **842949729-byte ZIP** has SHA-256 **92ae18e057860f1d90f289a3087910b9cc69a5d7e968be26cff507435138d148**. All earlier artifacts remain preserved.

Human whole-game balance/rendered/controller/device/listening/native-language acceptance, complete action art, physical second-computer LAN, full progression endurance and WAN/hosted rankings/recovery remain open. Browser automation is disabled. Alternate covers, bots/story and new gameplay expansion stay deferred. This remains a draft; protected main and the older hosted Site/Windows release are unchanged. No deployment, release replacement or contest submission.
